zh.question: 模擬用了幾層巢狀網格？各層涵蓋的地形與範圍是什麼？
zh.how_to_read: 底圖是最外層（d01）的地形高度；彩色線框是每一層巢狀網格的實際邊界（沿著該層自己的投影網格畫出，不是矩形經緯度框）。
zh.common_misreadings: 把巢狀邊界誤讀成矩形經緯度框——在 Lambert/Mercator 投影下邊界會是彎曲的；地形色階不代表任何模擬變數。

en.question: How many nested domains does this run have, and what terrain/extent does each cover?
en.how_to_read: The basemap is d01's own terrain height; the coloured outlines are each nest's real boundary, traced along that domain's own projected grid edge (not a lon/lat rectangle).
en.common_misreadings: Reading the nest outline as a straight lon/lat box -- it is curved under WRF's Lambert/Mercator projection; the terrain colour scale carries no simulated variable.

zh.question: 模式的探空和實際的無線電探空差多少？（任何個案，只要有 IGRA2 資料）
zh.how_to_read: 每個測站一張圖，每個時刻一個 Skew-T：實線是 WRF、虛線是 IGRA2 探空（溫度與露點，風標內側 WRF、外側探空），並列出 1000–500 hPa 的 T、Td、風速 RMSE。測站畫在涵蓋它的最細網格上，時刻取最接近雨峰的探空；數值在 soundings/sounding_obs_stats.csv。
zh.common_misreadings: 把探空的漂移（氣球在上升中飄離測站）與探空時間差忽略；一個測站的一次探空不代表整個區域的環境，1000–500 hPa 之外不計入 RMSE。

en.question: How far is the model sounding from the radiosonde? (any case with IGRA2 data)
en.how_to_read: One figure per station, one Skew-T per time: WRF solid, IGRA2 radiosonde dashed (temperature and dew point; barbs WRF inner, sonde outer), with the 1000-500 hPa RMSE of T, Td and wind speed. Each station is drawn on the finest domain holding it, at the soundings nearest the rain peak; numbers in soundings/sounding_obs_stats.csv.
en.common_misreadings: Ignoring balloon drift and the sonde-to-model time offset; one sounding is not the whole region's environment; levels outside 1000-500 hPa are not in the RMSE.

zh.question: 只改變 decomposition（切法）而不改變物理，答案漂移了多少？
zh.how_to_read: 每條線是一組（參考 run vs. 另一 run）逐格點最大 RMSE（diffwrf）隨時間的變化；縱軸對數尺度。
zh.common_misreadings: 把這條線當成模式誤差——它衡量的是純數值再現性雜訊，不是模式對觀測的誤差。

en.question: How much does the answer drift when only the decomposition changes, physics held fixed?
en.how_to_read: Each line is one (reference run vs. another run) pair's max per-field RMSE (diffwrf) over time; log y-axis.
en.common_misreadings: Reading this as model error against observations -- it measures pure numerical reproducibility noise, not skill.

zh.question: 要在 Met.3D 或 ParaView 裡做 3-D 互動分析，需要哪個檔？
zh.how_to_read: 這不是圖，是資料檔：每個 domain、每個選定時間一個 CF-1.8 NetCDF（wrf_d0N_pl_YYYYMMDD_HHMM.nc），維度 (time, isobaric, lat, lon)，等壓面 1000–100 hPa（高於模式頂 P_TOP 的層已移除），規則經緯度網格（間距約 dx/111.2 km 取到 0.01°），已排除側邊界鬆弛區。變數：溫度、地球座標 u/v、w、位勢高度、RH、QCLOUD/QICE/CLOUD_TOTAL（混合比）與地形高度。Met.3D 直接開；ParaView 用 NetCDF CF reader，並勾選 Replace Fill Value With Nan。
zh.common_misreadings: 把 _FillValue（9.96921e36）當成真實數值——它代表地面以下（低於最低模式層，不外插）、網格外或邊界區；把 QCLOUD/QICE 當成 CF 的質量分數——它們是對乾空氣的混合比；以為只有最後時刻——加 --every 才會依間隔輸出多個時刻。

en.question: Which file do I open in Met.3D or ParaView for interactive 3-D analysis?
en.how_to_read: This is a data file, not a figure: one CF-1.8 NetCDF per domain and selected time (wrf_d0N_pl_YYYYMMDD_HHMM.nc), dims (time, isobaric, lat, lon), pressure levels 1000-100 hPa (levels above the model top P_TOP removed), on a regular lon-lat grid (spacing ~dx/111.2 km rounded to 0.01 deg) with the lateral boundary relaxation zone excluded. Variables: temperature, earth-relative u/v, w, geopotential height, RH, QCLOUD/QICE/CLOUD_TOTAL (mixing ratios) and terrain height. Met.3D opens it directly; in ParaView use the NetCDF CF reader and tick Replace Fill Value With Nan.
en.common_misreadings: Taking the _FillValue (9.96921e36) as data -- it marks below ground (below the lowest model level; nothing is extrapolated), outside the native grid, or the boundary zone; reading QCLOUD/QICE as CF mass fractions -- they are mixing ratios per kg of dry air; assuming only the last time exists -- add --every to write one file per interval.

zh.question: 要在自己的工作站用 NCAR VAPOR 看 3-D 雲與地形，需要複製哪個資料夾？
zh.how_to_read: 這不是圖，是可直接複製的 bundle 資料夾（vapor/d0N/）：選定時間的 wrfout（每個時間一個檔，檔名的 ':' 換成 '_'，從 run hard link 而來，不佔額外空間；recipe 輸出與 run 不在同一檔案系統時不會複製，該 domain 記為 missing 並附上 `wtune post vapor-bundle ... --allow-copy` 指令與將複製的檔數、大小）、vapor_render.py（VAPOR Python API 算圖：地形 + QCLOUD/QICE isosurface，也可只存 .vs3 session）、README.md（rsync、conda 安裝、GUI 開法）與 bundle.json manifest。VAPOR 沒有 linux-aarch64 build，只能在 x86_64 Linux / macOS 工作站上跑，不能在 scc 上跑。
zh.common_misreadings: 以為 scc 上能直接跑 VAPOR——不行；以為 PNG 一定是不同時間——SetTimestep 是未驗證的呼叫，若被忽略每張 PNG 會是同一時間，README 有說明；以為垂直放大可以用腳本設定——只能在 GUI 調。

en.question: Which folder do I copy to my workstation to view 3-D clouds and terrain in NCAR VAPOR?
en.how_to_read: This is a ready-to-copy bundle folder (vapor/d0N/), not a figure: the selected wrfout frames (one time per file, ':' in the name replaced by '_', hard-linked from the run, so they cost no extra space; when the recipe output is on another filesystem nothing is copied -- that domain is a missing entry carrying the `wtune post vapor-bundle ... --allow-copy` command and the file count and size it would copy), vapor_render.py (VAPOR Python API: terrain plus QCLOUD/QICE isosurfaces, or a .vs3 session only), README.md (rsync, conda install, opening in the GUI) and a bundle.json manifest. VAPOR has no linux-aarch64 build: it runs on an x86_64 Linux / macOS workstation, not on scc.
en.common_misreadings: Expecting VAPOR to run on scc -- it cannot; assuming every PNG shows a different time -- SetTimestep is an unverified call, and if VAPOR ignores it every PNG shows the same time (see README); expecting the script to set vertical exaggeration -- that is GUI-only.

zh.question: 模式路徑跟最佳路徑（best track）差多遠？
zh.how_to_read: 黑線是 best track；彩色線是各 run 的模式路徑，直接畫自 a-deck/b-deck 檔案。
zh.common_misreadings: 把路徑接近誤讀成強度也準確——路徑與強度誤差是分開的分數，見下一張圖。

en.question: How far does the model track diverge from the best track?
en.how_to_read: Black is the best track; coloured lines are each run's model track, drawn straight from the a-deck/b-deck files.
en.common_misreadings: Assuming a close track means accurate intensity too -- track and intensity error are separate scores, see the next figure.

zh.question: 路徑誤差如何隨預報時間增長？
zh.how_to_read: MET tc_stat 逐 lead time 的 TK_ERR（km）。
zh.common_misreadings: 把單一 lead 的誤差當成整體技術分數——應看整條曲線的成長速率。

en.question: How does track error grow with forecast lead time?
en.how_to_read: MET tc_stat's TK_ERR (km) per lead time.
en.common_misreadings: Judging skill from one lead's error alone -- look at the growth rate across the whole curve.

zh.question: 最大風速／最低氣壓的誤差如何隨預報時間變化？
zh.how_to_read: MET tc_stat 的 AMAX_WIND／AMSLP 誤差對 lead time。
zh.common_misreadings: 把強度誤差跟路徑誤差混為一談——路徑準不代表強度準，反之亦然。

en.question: How does Vmax/MSLP error evolve with lead time?
en.how_to_read: MET tc_stat's AMAX_WIND/AMSLP error vs. lead time.
en.common_misreadings: Conflating intensity error with track error -- a good track does not imply good intensity, or vice versa.

zh.question: 34/50/64 kt 風圈半徑，模式跟最佳路徑比較起來準不準？
zh.how_to_read: MET tc_pairs 逐 lead time 的風圈半徑（km），模式對最佳路徑。
zh.common_misreadings: 把風圈半徑的差異當成強度誤差——風圈大小和中心強度（Vmax/MSLP）是不同的量，見另一張強度誤差圖。

en.question: How accurate are the model's 34/50/64 kt wind radii against the best track?
en.how_to_read: MET tc_pairs' wind-radius (km) vs. lead time, model vs. best track.
en.common_misreadings: Conflating a wind-radius difference with intensity error -- radius and central intensity (Vmax/MSLP) are different quantities; see the intensity-error figure.

zh.question: 颱風的軸對稱結構（切向風／徑向風隨半徑與高度）長什麼樣？
zh.how_to_read: MET tc_rmw 輸出的方位角平均剖面，單一時刻快照，橫軸為方位角索引、縱軸為半徑索引。
zh.common_misreadings: 把這張圖當成時間序列——tc_rmw 每次只處理一個檔案，這是單一時刻的結構，不是演變。

en.question: What does the storm's axisymmetric structure (tangential/radial wind by radius and height) look like?
en.how_to_read: MET tc_rmw's azimuthal-mean profile, a single-time snapshot; x-axis is azimuth index, y-axis is range index.
en.common_misreadings: Reading this as a time series -- tc_rmw processes one file at a time; this is one snapshot's structure, not its evolution.

zh.question: 10 m 切向風的結構隨半徑與預報時間如何演變（例如風圈是否隨時間擴張）？
zh.how_to_read: 橫軸為預報時間、縱軸為距中心半徑，色階為方位角平均切向風（氣旋式為正）。
zh.common_misreadings: 把顏色深淺直接讀成陣風速度——這是方位角平均值，會平滑掉不對稱結構（見象限風圈誤差圖）。

en.question: How does the 10 m tangential-wind structure evolve with both radius and lead time (e.g. is the wind field expanding)?
en.how_to_read: x-axis is lead time, y-axis is radius from the tracked centre, colour is the azimuthal-mean tangential wind (cyclonic positive).
en.common_misreadings: Reading the colour as a gust speed -- this is an azimuthal average, which smooths out asymmetric structure (see the quadrant wind-radii error figure).

zh.question: 颱風的雲場立體結構（雲牆、外圍螺旋雨帶）長什麼樣？
zh.how_to_read: ParaView 等值面：QCLOUD+QICE+QSNOW 的雲水混合比等值面，疊在地形之上，單一時刻快照。
zh.common_misreadings: 把等值面的大小/形狀當成量化的雲量——等值面只顯示超過門檻值的邊界，換一個門檻值形狀會完全不同。

en.question: What does the storm's 3-D cloud field (eyewall, outer spiral rainbands) look like?
en.how_to_read: A ParaView isosurface of total cloud water mixing ratio (QCLOUD+QICE+QSNOW) over terrain, one snapshot.
en.common_misreadings: Reading the isosurface's size/shape as a quantitative cloud amount -- it only shows the boundary above one threshold value; a different threshold gives a different shape.

zh.question: 對流系統目前的最大強度與空間分佈在哪裡？
zh.how_to_read: wrf-python 的 column-max 模擬回波（dBZ），近似雷達組合回波。
zh.common_misreadings: 把模擬回波直接跟真實雷達觀測比強度——沒有觀測比對時，這只是模式自身的診斷，不是驗證。

en.question: Where is the convective system currently strongest, and how is it distributed?
en.how_to_read: wrf-python's column-max simulated reflectivity (dBZ), analogous to a radar composite.
en.common_misreadings: Comparing this simulated reflectivity's absolute strength to real radar without an actual obs comparison -- without one, this is only a model-side diagnostic, not a verification.

zh.question: 哪裡有可用來對流的位能？
zh.how_to_read: MCAPE（J/kg）固定色階，超過上限以箭頭標示；斜線灰塊是 wrf-python cape_2d 無法計算的格點（沒有 LFC 或氣塊在近飽和層失敗），不是零值。
zh.common_misreadings: 把斜線灰塊當成 CAPE 為零——它是『未定義』；CAPE 大不代表會對流，還要看 CIN 與抬升。

en.question: Where is convective available potential energy?
en.how_to_read: MCAPE (J/kg) on a fixed scale with an overflow arrow; the hatched grey cells are where wrf-python cape_2d has no value (no LFC, or the parcel fails near saturation), not zeros.
en.common_misreadings: Reading the hatched cells as CAPE = 0 -- they are undefined; large CAPE does not mean convection, CIN and lift matter.

zh.question: 對流啟動前要克服多少抑制？
zh.how_to_read: MCIN（J/kg）色階 0–100，超過以箭頭標示（整個範圍多數小於 40，所以放大低值端）；斜線灰塊是無 LFC 而未定義的格點。
zh.common_misreadings: 把 MCIN 定義為零與『未定義』混為一談；灰塊內沒有 CIN 數值。

en.question: How much inhibition must be overcome before convection starts?
en.how_to_read: MCIN (J/kg) on a 0-100 scale with an overflow arrow (most of the domain is below 40, so the low end is resolved); hatched grey cells are undefined (no LFC).
en.common_misreadings: Confusing MCIN = 0 with 'undefined'; inside the hatched cells there is no CIN value.

zh.question: 整段模擬期間哪裡出現過最強的中氣旋（mesocyclone）訊號？
zh.how_to_read: 2-5 km 上升螺旋度（wrf-python uhel）逐時刻取最大值後疊合，排除 spin-up。
zh.common_misreadings: 把時間最大值當成某一時刻的即時狀態——這是整段期間的峰值疊合圖，不代表任何單一時間點的真實分佈。

en.question: Where did the strongest mesocyclone signal occur anywhere during the run?
en.how_to_read: 2-5 km updraft helicity (wrf-python's uhel), taken as a pointwise time-maximum across post-spin-up frames.
en.common_misreadings: Reading the time-max field as a snapshot at any one instant -- it is the peak over the whole period, not the real state at any single time.

zh.question: 代表性測站的垂直溫濕層結與風切如何支持（或抑制）對流？
zh.how_to_read: MetPy Skew-T/hodograph，取樣於最大回波格點；圖上標有地面起始 CAPE/CIN。
zh.common_misreadings: 把單一格點的探空當成整個 domain 的代表——這只是一個代表點，鄰近格點可能差異很大，尤其在對流尺度。

en.question: How does the vertical thermodynamic/wind profile at a representative point support (or suppress) convection?
en.how_to_read: A MetPy Skew-T/hodograph at the max-reflectivity grid column, with surface-based CAPE/CIN annotated.
en.common_misreadings: Treating one column's sounding as representative of the whole domain -- convective-scale variability between neighbouring columns can be large.

zh.question: 模式的最大柱反射率與雷達合成反射率在位置與強度上是否一致？
zh.how_to_read: 左為模式 mdbz、右為雷達合成反射率（NEXRAD Level II，經 Py-ART 網格化取柱最大值；2020-10-14 之後改用 MRMS），同一 dBZ 色階、同一格網（cdo remapnn），只畫兩者皆有值的格點；選取觀測 ≥35 dBZ 面積最大的時刻。若專案沒有 MRMS／NEXRAD，會改用 agent 找來並通過 `wtune event obs-check` 的雷達資料（wtune-obs/1 的 refl_*.nc），來源見圖下標示。
zh.common_misreadings: 把雷達範圍外當成『無回波』——範圍外是缺值；雷達合成是掃描體積內插，模式 mdbz 是 Thompson/WSM 等方案的公式，兩者定義不完全相同。

en.question: Do model max-column reflectivity and the radar composite agree in position and intensity?
en.how_to_read: Left model mdbz, right radar composite (NEXRAD Level II gridded with Py-ART, column maximum; MRMS after 2020-10-14), one dBZ scale, one grid (cdo remapnn), matched cells only; the time with the most observed area >= 35 dBZ is shown. Without MRMS / NEXRAD the comparison uses radar data an agent fetched (wtune-obs/1 refl_*.nc, passed `wtune event obs-check`); the source tag names it.
en.common_misreadings: Treating cells beyond radar range as 'no echo' -- they are missing; the radar composite is a volume-scan interpolation while model mdbz is a scheme-dependent formula, so the two are not the same quantity.

zh.question: 回波型態在不同空間尺度下與雷達吻合到什麼程度？
zh.how_to_read: MET Grid-Stat NBRCNT FSS（觀測：雷達合成），鄰域寬度 1/3/5/9 格點（乘以模式格距換成公里），各取樣時刻依 FBS 彙整；虛線為有用技巧 0.5+f0/2。若專案沒有 MRMS／NEXRAD，會改用 agent 找來並通過 `wtune event obs-check` 的雷達資料（wtune-obs/1 的 refl_*.nc），來源見圖下標示。
zh.common_misreadings: 與降水 FSS 相同：稀有門檻的 f0 很小，FSS 偏低是構造性的；合成範圍外不計。

en.question: How well does the echo pattern match the radar across spatial scales?
en.how_to_read: MET Grid-Stat NBRCNT FSS (observation: radar composite), neighbourhood widths 1/3/5/9 points (x model grid spacing), pooled over the sampled times through the FBS terms; dotted line = useful skill 0.5 + f0/2. Without MRMS / NEXRAD the comparison uses radar data an agent fetched (wtune-obs/1 refl_*.nc, passed `wtune event obs-check`); the source tag names it.
en.common_misreadings: As for precipitation FSS: rare thresholds have small f0 so low FSS is built in; cells outside radar range are excluded.

zh.question: 雨帶在什麼時候、落在跨雨帶方向的哪裡？模式與觀測的位置和時間差多少？
zh.how_to_read: 橫軸是沿一條線的距離（km，0 為線的中心），縱軸是時間（UTC，往上為後）。預設的線穿過雨核、垂直於雨峰時 0–1.5 km 的平均風，所以順著低層氣流排列的雨帶會在圖上呈現跨氣流方向的位置；負值在氣流右側、正值在左側（西南氣流時是東南→西北）。每個觀測資料集兩欄（觀測與同時窗的模式累積），最後一欄是模式逐時雨量；灰色是 spin-up，虛線是雨峰時刻。線可用 `wtune project set --cross-section hovmoller=lat0,lon0,lat1,lon1` 指定；數值在 precip_hovmoller_<run>.csv。
zh.common_misreadings: 把一條線上的位置差當成整個雨帶的位移；觀測時窗（例如 6 小時）比模式逐時粗，時間差小於時窗長度時看不出來；格點雨量（如 CMORPH 0.25°）解析不了 3 km 模式的地形雨核。

en.question: When, and where across the rain band, did it rain? How far off are the model's position and timing?
en.how_to_read: x: distance along a line (km, 0 = the line centre); y: time (UTC, later upward). The default line crosses the rain core perpendicular to the 0-1.5 km mean wind at the rain peak, so a band lying along the low-level flow shows its cross-flow position; negative = right of the flow, positive = left (south-east -> north-west for south-west flow). Two columns per observation dataset (observed and the model over the same windows), then the model's hourly rain; grey = spin-up, dashed = the rain peak. Set the line with `wtune project set --cross-section hovmoller=lat0,lon0,lat1,lon1`; values in precip_hovmoller_<run>.csv.
en.common_misreadings: Reading a position difference on one line as the displacement of the whole band; an observation window (e.g. 6 h) coarser than the model's hour hides timing errors shorter than it; gridded estimates (e.g. CMORPH 0.25 deg) do not resolve a 3 km model's terrain rain cores.

zh.question: 從模擬開始累積到目前，降水總量與空間分佈如何？
zh.how_to_read: RAINC+RAINNC（mm），wrf-python，自運轉起始累積（包含 spin-up 期間的降水）。
zh.common_misreadings: 把這張圖當成某一時段的降水率——這是累積量，不是速率；也不要把 spin-up 期間的累積量誤讀成已被排除。

en.question: How much has accumulated, and where, from the run's start to now?
en.how_to_read: RAINC+RAINNC (mm), accumulated since the run's own start (spin-up-period rain IS included in this total, per WRF's own convention).
en.common_misreadings: Reading this as a rain RATE for some interval -- it is a cumulative total, and the spin-up exclusion elsewhere in this report does not remove spin-up rain from this particular total.

zh.question: 模式累積降水的位置與強度和 NCEP Stage IV 觀測相比如何？
zh.how_to_read: 左為模式、右為 Stage IV，同一色階、同一格點；只畫兩者皆有值的匹配格點，並限制在模式內部（去掉 spec_bdy_width 邊界區）且在 NEXRAD 站 230 km 範圍內。模式先以 cdo remapcon 轉到經緯度格網，再由 MET Grid-Stat 以 BUDGET 法重新網格化到 Stage IV 自身的 HRAP 4.76 km 格網。資料來源：NCEP Stage IV（IEM 鏡像）。
zh.common_misreadings: 把雷達範圍外（如遠海）當成『觀測無雨』——Stage IV 在那裡是 0 而非缺值，所以圖上只用雷達範圍內的格點；Stage IV 是雷達加雨量計的分析，不是真值。

en.question: How do model accumulated-precipitation position and amount compare with NCEP Stage IV?
en.how_to_read: Left model, right Stage IV, one colour scale, matched cells only, inside the model interior (spec_bdy_width cells excluded) and within 230 km of a NEXRAD site. The model is moved to a lat/lon grid with cdo remapcon, then MET Grid-Stat regrids it (BUDGET) onto Stage IV's own 4.76 km HRAP grid. Observation: NCEP Stage IV (IEM mirror).
en.common_misreadings: Treating cells beyond radar range (open sea) as 'observed dry' -- Stage IV holds 0, not missing, there, which is why the mask is applied; Stage IV is a radar+gauge analysis, not truth.

zh.question: 模式與 Stage IV 的降水差在哪裡、差多少？
zh.how_to_read: 模式減 Stage IV（mm），同一匹配格點與遮罩（見上一張圖）；紅＝模式偏多，藍＝偏少，色階對稱。差值直接由 MET Grid-Stat 的配對格點（Stage IV 格網）算出。
zh.common_misreadings: 把雙重懲罰（位置偏一點就同時出現一紅一藍）當成強度偏差；請與 FSS 一起看。

en.question: Where and by how much does model precipitation differ from Stage IV?
en.how_to_read: Model minus Stage IV (mm) on the same matched cells and mask as the previous figure; red = model wetter, blue = drier, symmetric scale. Computed from the Grid-Stat matched pairs on the Stage IV grid.
en.common_misreadings: Reading the double penalty (a slightly displaced cell gives a red and a blue patch) as an amount bias; read it together with FSS.

zh.question: 在 0.254/2.54/6.35/12.7/25.4/50 mm（0.01–2 英寸）各門檻下，模式對降水事件的命中與誤報如何？
zh.how_to_read: MET Grid-Stat 的 CTS 線（觀測：NCEP Stage IV）：POD（PODY）、FAR、CSI 與頻率偏差 FBIAS（1 為完美），橫軸為門檻；n 為匹配格點數。
zh.common_misreadings: 在門檻高、事件很少時把 CSI 的高低當成穩定結論——樣本極小；FBIAS 遠大於 1 表示模式的強降水範圍過大或位置偏離。

en.question: How well does the model hit or falsely alarm precipitation events at 0.254/2.54/6.35/12.7/25.4/50 mm (0.01-2 in)?
en.how_to_read: MET Grid-Stat CTS lines (observation: NCEP Stage IV): POD (PODY), FAR, CSI and frequency bias FBIAS (1 = perfect) against threshold; n is the number of matched points.
en.common_misreadings: Trusting CSI at high thresholds where events are very few; FBIAS far above 1 means the model's heavy-rain area is too large or displaced.

zh.question: 降水型態在不同空間尺度下與觀測吻合到什麼程度？
zh.how_to_read: MET Grid-Stat NBRCNT 的 Fractions Skill Score（觀測：NCEP Stage IV），鄰域寬度 1/3/5/9 格點（乘以 4.76 km 換成公里），每個門檻一條線；同色虛線是『有用技巧』門檻 0.5+f0/2（f0＝觀測事件頻率）。
zh.common_misreadings: FSS 低就是模式壞——強降水門檻的觀測頻率 f0 極小時 FSS 本來就很低；請與虛線比較，而非只看絕對值。

en.question: How well does the precipitation pattern match observations across spatial scales?
en.how_to_read: MET Grid-Stat NBRCNT Fractions Skill Score (observation: NCEP Stage IV) for neighbourhood widths 1/3/5/9 points (x 4.76 km), one line per threshold; the dotted line of the same colour is the useful-skill level 0.5 + f0/2 with f0 the observed event frequency.
en.common_misreadings: Reading low FSS as a bad model -- at rare heavy-rain thresholds f0 is tiny and FSS is low by construction; compare with the dotted line, not the absolute value.

zh.question: 500 hPa 的槽脊與渦度分佈如何，大尺度環流是否合理？
zh.how_to_read: 等值線為 500 hPa 高度場（m），填色為絕對渦度（1e-5 /s，wrf-python avo）。
zh.common_misreadings: 把渦度的正負號跟氣旋/反氣旋方向搞反——北半球正渦度對應氣旋式環流。

en.question: Is the large-scale 500 hPa trough/ridge and vorticity pattern physically reasonable?
en.how_to_read: Contours: 500 hPa height (m). Fill: absolute vorticity (1e-5 s-1, wrf-python's avo).
en.common_misreadings: Getting vorticity's sign backwards relative to rotation sense -- positive vorticity is cyclonic in the NH.

zh.question: 地面氣壓系統的位置，以及對應的冷暖空氣層厚（間接顯示鋒面）在哪裡？
zh.how_to_read: 填色為 SLP（hPa），等值線為 1000-500 hPa 厚度（m，z500-z1000）。
zh.common_misreadings: 把厚度值直接讀成溫度——厚度是氣層平均虛溫的代表量，不是單一高度的溫度。

en.question: Where are the surface pressure systems, and where does the 1000-500 hPa thickness (a proxy for fronts) place the cold/warm air?
en.how_to_read: Fill: SLP (hPa). Contours: 1000-500 hPa thickness (m, z500-z1000).
en.common_misreadings: Reading thickness as a direct temperature value -- it represents the mean virtual temperature of the layer, not a single-level temperature.

zh.question: 850 hPa 的暖濕舌與低層噴流在哪裡？
zh.how_to_read: 填色為相當位溫 theta-e（K），風標為 850 hPa 風。
zh.common_misreadings: 把 theta-e 高值區直接等同降水區——它顯示的是位置與潛在不穩定,還需配合垂直運動場判斷。

en.question: Where is the 850 hPa warm/moist tongue and low-level jet?
en.how_to_read: Fill: equivalent potential temperature theta-e (K). Barbs: 850 hPa wind.
en.common_misreadings: Equating high theta-e directly with a rain area -- it marks moisture/potential instability, which still needs a lifting mechanism to realize.

zh.question: 高空噴流的軸線與強度在哪裡（影響地面系統發展的動力支持）？
zh.how_to_read: 填色為 250 hPa 風速（m/s）。
zh.common_misreadings: 把風速極大值誤讀成噴流入口/出口區——需搭配風向與曲率才能判斷入出口象限。

en.question: Where is the upper-level jet axis and how strong is it (the dynamical support for surface development)?
en.how_to_read: Fill: 250 hPa wind speed (m/s).
en.common_misreadings: Reading the speed maximum alone as an entrance/exit region -- that judgement also needs wind direction and curvature.

zh.question: 地面溫度與風場的空間分佈是否合理（例如海陸風、鋒面通過）？
zh.how_to_read: 填色為 T2（K），風標為 10 m 風。
zh.common_misreadings: 把 T2 單位當成攝氏度——wrf-python 的 T2 預設輸出為 K。

en.question: Is the surface temperature/wind pattern reasonable (e.g. sea breeze, a frontal passage)?
en.how_to_read: Fill: T2 (K). Barbs: 10 m wind.
en.common_misreadings: Assuming T2 is in Celsius -- wrf-python's T2 defaults to K.

zh.question: 模式的 500 hPa 高度場相對 ERA5 分析場偏差在哪裡、多大？
zh.how_to_read: 填色為模式減 ERA5 的 500 hPa 高度差（m，於 ERA5 0.25° 格點上、僅計模式內部區域）；黑實線為模式、黑虛線為 ERA5 的 500 hPa 高度（每 60 m），兩者錯位處即位置誤差，對應填色的正負偶極。標題的 RMSE/bias 來自 MET Grid-Stat。
zh.common_misreadings: 把整片淡色當成「無誤差」：零附近的一格（約 ±8 m）刻意為白色；側邊界區（spec_bdy_width）不計入統計，底色同為白色。

en.question: Where and how large is the model's 500 hPa height bias against the ERA5 analysis?
en.how_to_read: Fill: model minus ERA5 z500 (m); on the ERA5 0.25 deg grid, model interior only; black solid = model, black dashed = ERA5 z500 every 60 m, so a displaced feature shows as offset contours and a +/- dipole in the fill. RMSE/bias in the title come from MET Grid-Stat.
en.common_misreadings: Reading the pale fill as 'no error': the bin around zero (about +/-8 m) is deliberately white, and the lateral boundary zone (spec_bdy_width) is excluded from the statistics and shares that white background.

zh.question: 模式的低層噴流和它帶的水氣，與 ERA5 再分析差多少？
zh.how_to_read: 左圖：850 hPa 風速 model − ERA5（m/s），黑色箭頭是模式風、灰色是 ERA5；右圖：850 hPa 比濕 model − ERA5（g/kg）。紅色＝模式風較強，棕色＝模式較乾。時刻同其他單時刻地圖（雨峰）；RMSE 與偏差由 MET Grid-Stat 在 ERA5 0.25° 網格、模式內部範圍計算。
zh.common_misreadings: 把 ERA5 當成觀測——它是再分析，在海上與資料稀少處本身也有誤差；850 hPa 在高山（青藏高原、中央山脈）位於地面以下，那裡沒有差值；0.25° 的 ERA5 無法解析 3 km 網格的地形噴流。

en.question: How far are the model's low-level jet and the moisture it carries from ERA5?
en.how_to_read: Left: 850 hPa wind speed, model - ERA5 (m/s), model wind black, ERA5 grey; right: 850 hPa specific humidity, model - ERA5 (g/kg). Red = the model's wind is stronger, brown = the model is drier. Same time as the other one-time maps (the rain peak); RMSE and bias from MET Grid-Stat on the ERA5 0.25 deg grid over the model interior.
en.common_misreadings: Taking ERA5 for an observation: it is a reanalysis with its own error over the ocean and where data are sparse; 850 hPa is below the ground over high terrain, where there is no difference; 0.25 deg ERA5 does not resolve terrain jets of a 3 km grid.

zh.question: 邊界層結構如何隨地形起伏變化（例如背風波、邊界層深度隨地形變化）？
zh.how_to_read: 填色為位溫 theta（K）沿一條跨地形剖線；灰色填滿區為地形。
zh.common_misreadings: 把剖線當成任意方向的代表——目前預設為通過 domain 中心列的東西向直線，不是針對特定地形特徵挑選的。

en.question: How does the boundary-layer structure vary with terrain (e.g. lee waves, PBL depth over terrain)?
en.how_to_read: Fill: potential temperature theta (K) along a cross-terrain line; the grey fill is terrain.
en.common_misreadings: Assuming the cross-section line was chosen for a specific terrain feature -- the default is simply the domain's own centre-row west-east line.

zh.question: 邊界層深度與熱力結構如何隨時間演變（例如日變化）？
zh.how_to_read: 填色為位溫 theta（K）時間-高度剖面，紅線為 PBLH（邊界層高度），取樣於 domain 中心格點。
zh.common_misreadings: 把單一格點的時間-高度圖當成整個 domain 的代表——邊界層深度在地形複雜區域空間變異可能很大。

en.question: How does boundary-layer depth and thermal structure evolve over time (e.g. diurnal cycle)?
en.how_to_read: Fill: potential temperature theta (K) time-height section; red line: PBLH, sampled at the domain's centre column.
en.common_misreadings: Treating one column's time-height plot as representative of the whole domain -- PBL depth can vary a lot spatially over complex terrain.

zh.question: 污染物濃度的空間分佈與盛行風場的關係如何？
zh.how_to_read: 填色為偵測到的物種（見圖說標註的 species，例如 PM2_5_DRY），風標為 10 m 風，取自最低模式層。
zh.common_misreadings: 把最低層濃度當成地面實測濃度——模式最低層並非精確對應觀測站的量測高度。

en.question: How does pollutant concentration relate to the prevailing wind field?
en.how_to_read: Fill: whichever species was detected (see the figure's own 'species' note, e.g. PM2_5_DRY) at the lowest model level. Barbs: 10 m wind.
en.common_misreadings: Treating the lowest-model-level concentration as an in-situ station reading -- the model's lowest level is not exactly at station measurement height.

zh.question: 測站觀測的濃度時序跟模式比較起來如何？

zh.question: 模式的月平均年變化與參考資料相比如何？
zh.how_to_read: 四個區域（華北、華南、台灣、西北太平洋）的月平均：T2（海洋區用 SST）對 ERA5 月平均（由 ARCO 逐時資料彙整），降水對 GPCP v2.3；spin-up 的那個月不計入。
zh.common_misreadings: 把模式與 ERA5 的差全部當成模式誤差——ERA5 本身是再分析；GPCP 只有 2.5°，區域降水比較受解析度差異影響。

en.question: How does the model's monthly annual cycle compare with the references?
en.how_to_read: Monthly means for four boxes (North China, South China, Taiwan, W North Pacific): T2 (SST over the ocean box) against ERA5 monthly means aggregated from the ARCO hourly store, precipitation against GPCP v2.3; the spin-up month is excluded.
en.common_misreadings: Reading every model-minus-ERA5 difference as model error -- ERA5 is itself a reanalysis; GPCP is 2.5 deg, so box precipitation is affected by the resolution mismatch.

zh.question: 各成員的低壓中心與系統形狀分歧多大？
zh.how_to_read: 畫一條封閉的 SLP 等值線，位於『所有成員最小值中最高者 + 10 hPa』，星號標出各成員最低壓位置；成員只差在初始與邊界分析（多分析集合），物理設定相同。
zh.common_misreadings: 把散布當成完整的預報不確定度——只反映分析不確定，不含模式物理誤差。

en.question: How much do the members disagree on the low-pressure centre and system shape?
en.how_to_read: A closed SLP contour at (highest member minimum + 10 hPa), with a star at each member's minimum; the members differ only in the initial and boundary analysis (multi-analysis ensemble), physics identical.
en.common_misreadings: Reading the spread as full forecast uncertainty -- it reflects analysis uncertainty only, not model-physics error.

zh.question: 累積降水超過門檻的機率分布如何？
zh.how_to_read: 自 t0 起累積降水 ≥ 門檻的成員比例；側邊界區已遮蔽；機率只取 k/N 的離散值（N 為成員數）。
zh.common_misreadings: 把 k/N 當成連續的校準機率；成員少時階梯狀明顯，也未經校準。

en.question: Where is accumulated rain above the threshold likely?
en.how_to_read: Fraction of members with rain accumulated since t0 >= threshold; the lateral boundary zone is blanked; values are discrete k/N (N = members).
en.common_misreadings: Reading k/N as a calibrated continuous probability; with few members it is stair-stepped and uncalibrated.

zh.question: 颱風的眼、眼牆與螺旋雨帶在哪裡、多強？
zh.how_to_read: 以颱風中心為準的 600 km × 600 km 範圍（超出 domain 時截斷）；填色為 2 km AGL（離地高度）的雷達回波 dBZ（NWS 色表，5 dBZ 一級，wrf-python dbz 經 interplevel 內插）；黑色等值線為 10 m 風速 34/50/64 kt（NHC 風圈門檻），洋紅虛線圓為 RMW（10 m 方位角平均切向風最大處的半徑），+ 為中心（最低海平面氣壓路徑 minimum-SLP track；無路徑時為平滑後 SLP 最小值 minimum SLP (smoothed)）。dx > 4 km 時標題註明眼／眼牆解析不足。
zh.common_misreadings: 把 12 km 網格上的寬大眼牆當成真實尺寸——眼與眼牆只有數個網格寬時會被抹寬；把 34 kt 等值線當成 NHC 風圈半徑——這裡畫的是整個風速場的等值線，不是四象限最大半徑；把模式回波當成雷達觀測——它是由微物理混合比推算的反射率。

en.question: Where are the eye, eyewall and spiral rainbands, and how strong are they?
en.how_to_read: Storm-centred 600 km x 600 km box (clipped to the domain); fill is reflectivity (dBZ, NWS table, 5 dBZ steps) at 2 km AGL (wrf-python dbz interpolated with interplevel); black contours are 10 m wind 34/50/64 kt (NHC wind-radii thresholds), the magenta dashed ring is the RMW (radius of the max 10 m azimuthal-mean tangential wind), + is the centre (minimum-SLP track, else minimum SLP (smoothed)). With dx > 4 km the title says the eye/eyewall are under-resolved.
en.common_misreadings: Taking a broad eyewall on a 12 km grid as its real size -- an eye only a few cells wide is smeared out; reading the 34 kt contour as the NHC wind radius -- this is the contour of the whole field, not the per-quadrant maximum extent; treating model reflectivity as radar data -- it is derived from the microphysics mixing ratios.

zh.question: 颱風的雲頂多冷、中央密集雲區與外圍雲帶的範圍？
zh.how_to_read: OLR 換算的等效黑體溫度 (OLR/σ)^0.25，全 domain；240 K 以上為反向灰階（暖=深、冷=白），240 K 以下加上彩色強化（仿 NOAA enhanced IR），色條同時標 K 與 °C。cloud 圖組已畫同一 domain 時這張不重複畫。
zh.common_misreadings: 把它當成衛星紅外頻道亮溫——這是寬頻 OLR 的代理量，不是衛星頻道輻射傳輸模擬，在高雲上比窗區頻道亮溫偏暖，不能與 GOES 亮溫逐 K 比較。

en.question: How cold are the cloud tops, and how large are the central dense overcast and the outer cloud bands?
en.how_to_read: Equivalent blackbody temperature (OLR/sigma)^0.25 over the whole domain; reverse greyscale above 240 K (warm = dark, cold = white) and a colour enhancement below it (NOAA-style enhanced IR); the colour bar is in K and degC. Not drawn when the cloud set already draws it for this domain.
en.common_misreadings: Reading it as a satellite IR channel brightness temperature -- it is a broadband OLR proxy, not a radiative-transfer simulation of a satellite channel, and is warmer than a window-channel Tb over high cloud, so it cannot be compared K-for-K with GOES.

zh.question: 颱風的主環流與次環流（入流、眼牆上升、高層外流）在半徑-高度上怎麼分布？RMW 隨高度如何外傾？
zh.how_to_read: 以中心為準的方位角平均剖面，半徑 0–300 km（每格 dx 一個 bin）、高度 0–18 km MSL（每 0.5 km）；填色為切向風 Vt（5 m/s 一級，負值為黑色虛線），向量為（徑向風 Vr，w×10）——w 放大 10 倍才看得見，圖例有標；藍線為 RMW(z)。ua/va 在模式原生投影網格上對中心旋轉成徑向／切向分量（網格相對風，與網格座標一致）。斜線區為地面以下。
zh.common_misreadings: 把向量的傾角當成真實的氣流斜率——w 已放大 10 倍；把粗網格上的平滑 RMW 外傾當成真實眼牆傾斜——dx > 4 km 時眼牆解析不足；忽略中心定位誤差（±dx/2）對小半徑方位角平均的影響。

en.question: How are the primary and secondary circulations (inflow, eyewall ascent, upper outflow) distributed in radius and height, and how does the RMW slope outward with height?
en.how_to_read: Azimuthal means about the centre, radius 0-300 km (one bin per dx), height 0-18 km MSL (0.5 km); fill is tangential wind Vt (5 m/s steps, negative values dashed black), vectors are (radial wind Vr, w x10) -- w is magnified 10 times to be visible, as the key states; the blue line is RMW(z). ua/va are rotated about the centre in the native projected grid (grid-relative winds, consistent with the grid axes). Hatched = below ground.
en.common_misreadings: Reading the vector tilt as the true streamline slope -- w is magnified x10; taking the smooth RMW slope on a coarse grid as the real eyewall tilt -- the eyewall is under-resolved at dx > 4 km; ignoring that a +-dx/2 centre error blurs the small-radius azimuthal mean.

zh.question: 颱風的暖心在哪個高度、有多強？
zh.how_to_read: T' = 方位角平均溫度 T(r,z) 減去同高度 500–1000 km 環狀區（環境）的平均；domain 容不下 1000 km 時改用 domain 內最大的完整環狀區（內外半徑比相同），標題會說明。紅藍發散色表、對稱、1 K 一級；黑線為位溫 theta，每 10 K。
zh.common_misreadings: 把環境環狀區縮小後的 T' 與用 500–1000 km 算的值直接比較——參考環境不同，數值不同；把近地面的負 T' 當成冷心——那多半是降水蒸發冷卻或地形，不是颱風結構。

en.question: At what height is the warm core and how strong is it?
en.how_to_read: T' = azimuthal-mean temperature T(r,z) minus the mean over the 500-1000 km annulus (the environment) at the same height; when the domain cannot hold 1000 km the largest full annulus in the domain (same inner/outer ratio) is used and the title says so. Diverging RdBu_r, symmetric, 1 K steps; black lines are potential temperature theta every 10 K.
en.common_misreadings: Comparing T' from a reduced annulus directly with a 500-1000 km value -- the reference environment differs, so the numbers differ; reading negative T' near the surface as a cold core -- it is usually rain-evaporation cooling or terrain, not the vortex structure.

zh.question: 眼牆與雨帶的雲和降水粒子在半徑-高度上怎麼分布？哪裡在上升？
zh.how_to_read: 方位角平均的總凝結物（所有水凝物種類加總，對數色階 0.01–1 g/kg）；紅色實線為上升 w（0.25/0.5/1 m/s），藍色虛線為下沉；粗黑線為 0 °C 等溫線（融化層）。
zh.common_misreadings: 把只用 QCLOUD+QICE 的舊圖跟這張比——舊圖只畫了約一成的凝結物質量；把 0.01 g/kg 的淡色區當成厚雲——那是雲邊緣與砧狀雲；方位角平均會把不對稱的雨帶抹成環。

en.question: How are cloud and precipitation particles of the eyewall and rainbands distributed in radius and height, and where is the ascent?
en.how_to_read: Azimuthal-mean total condensate (sum of all hydrometeor species, log scale 0.01-1 g/kg); red solid = updraft w (0.25/0.5/1 m/s), blue dashed = downdraft; the bold black line is the 0 degC isotherm (melting level).
en.common_misreadings: Comparing with the old QCLOUD+QICE figures -- those drew about a tenth of the condensate mass; reading the faint 0.01 g/kg shade as thick cloud -- it is cloud edge and anvil; the azimuthal mean smears asymmetric rainbands into rings.

zh.question: 通過颱風中心的垂直剖面上，眼、眼牆與雨帶的回波和上升氣流長什麼樣？
zh.how_to_read: 兩個剖面通過中心：沿模式網格 x 軸（約西-東）與 y 軸（約南-北），各 ±300 km（超出 domain 時截斷）、0–18 km；填色為回波 dBZ（NWS 色表），紅/藍線為上升/下沉 w，實線 0 °C、虛線 −20 °C；灰色為地形。
zh.common_misreadings: 把網格軸當成正東西／南北——Lambert 投影上網格軸與經線有夾角，離標準經線越遠越大；把單一剖面當成整個颱風的代表——眼牆與雨帶是不對稱的，請配合方位角平均圖看。

en.question: What do the eye, eyewall and rainbands look like in reflectivity and updraft on vertical sections through the centre?
en.how_to_read: Two sections through the centre: along the model grid x axis (about west-east) and y axis (about south-north), +-300 km each (clipped to the domain), 0-18 km; fill is reflectivity (dBZ, NWS table), red/blue lines are up/down w, solid 0 degC and dashed -20 degC isotherms; grey is terrain.
en.common_misreadings: Taking the grid axes as exactly east-west/south-north -- on a Lambert grid they are rotated from the meridians, more so away from the standard longitude; taking one section as representative of the whole storm -- the eyewall and rainbands are asymmetric; read it with the azimuthal-mean figures.

zh.question: 颱風暖心的強度與高度隨時間怎麼變（增強、衰減）？
zh.how_to_read: 橫軸為時間（--every 間隔；未指定時全部 frame，超過 60 個時均勻取 60 個），縱軸為高度 0–18 km；填色為眼區 T'＝中心 r ≤ dx 範圍的平均溫度減去環境環狀區平均（同 rz 暖心圖的定義），紅藍對稱 1 K 一級。每個時間都重新定位中心。
zh.common_misreadings: 把中心定位跳動造成的條紋當成暖心振盪——粗網格或眼區很小時，中心差一格就會改變眼區平均；環狀區在 domain 邊界附近會隨中心位置縮放，前後時間的參考環境可能不同。

en.question: How do the strength and height of the warm core change with time (intensification, decay)?
en.how_to_read: x is time (the --every cadence; without it every frame, or 60 evenly spaced frames when there are more), y is height 0-18 km; fill is the eye T' = mean temperature within r <= dx of the centre minus the environment annulus mean (same definition as the r-z warm-core figure), RdBu_r symmetric, 1 K steps. The centre is re-located in every frame.
en.common_misreadings: Reading stripes caused by centre jumps as warm-core oscillations -- on a coarse grid or a small eye a one-cell centre shift changes the eye mean; near the domain edge the annulus scales with the centre position, so the reference environment can differ between times.

zh.question: 颱風的總凝結物立體結構（眼牆、雨帶、外流雲砧）長什麼樣？
zh.how_to_read: ParaView 體積繪圖，以颱風中心為準的 600 km 方框，靠近相機的一半切開以看見眼與眼牆內部；單一時刻快照。
zh.common_misreadings: 把體積的不透明度當成定量雲量——轉換函數的選擇會改變外觀；垂直方向有誇張倍率。

en.question: What does the storm's 3-D total-condensate structure (eyewall, rainbands, outflow anvil) look like?
en.how_to_read: A ParaView volume rendering of a storm-centred 600 km box, with the camera-side half cut away to show the eye and eyewall interior; one snapshot.
en.common_misreadings: Reading volume opacity as a quantitative cloud amount -- the transfer function shapes the look; the vertical axis is exaggerated.

zh.question: 地形起伏如何影響近地面與 700 hPa 的風場？
zh.how_to_read: 底圖為地形高度；黑色風羽是 10 m 風，紅色風羽是 700 hPa 風——比較兩者可看出地形對低層風的阻擋/加速/轉向。
zh.common_misreadings: 把 700 hPa 風誤讀為近地表風；地形色階本身不是任何動力變數。

en.question: How does complex terrain shape the near-surface vs. 700 hPa flow?
en.how_to_read: Terrain height fills the map; black barbs are 10 m wind, red barbs are 700 hPa wind -- comparing them shows blocking/acceleration/channelling by terrain.
en.common_misreadings: Reading the 700 hPa wind as the surface wind; the terrain colour scale is not a dynamical field.

zh.question: 跨越主山脊的垂直環流長什麼樣子？
zh.how_to_read: 填色為 theta（位溫），等值線為垂直風 w；剖面線預設過最高點、沿 700 hPa 平均風向。x 軸是沿剖面的格點索引，不是實際距離。
zh.common_misreadings: 把 x 軸當成等距的地理距離；剖面線方向是格點空間近似，非精確地理方位角。

en.question: What does the cross-ridge vertical circulation look like?
en.how_to_read: Fill is potential temperature (theta), contours are vertical velocity w; the line defaults through the peak, along the mean 700 hPa wind. The x-axis is a grid-index position along the line, not physical distance.
en.common_misreadings: Treating the x-axis as evenly-spaced physical distance; the line direction is a grid-index approximation, not an exact geographic bearing.

zh.question: 降水集中在地形的哪一側（迎風/背風）？
zh.how_to_read: 填色為累積雨量，棕色等值線為地形高度——雨量極大值常沿等高線密集處（迎風坡）出現，即地形性降水。
zh.common_misreadings: 把等高線本身當成雨量；忽略雨量已包含 spin-up 期間的累積（見下方標註排除時數）。

en.question: Which side of the terrain (windward/leeward) does rain concentrate on?
en.how_to_read: Fill is accumulated rain, brown contours are terrain height -- rain maxima often sit where contours bunch on the windward slope (orographic precipitation).
en.common_misreadings: Reading the terrain contours themselves as rain; the accumulation already spans the spin-up period (see the stamped excluded hours below).

zh.question: 山谷是否有冷池或逆溫層形成？
zh.how_to_read: 在地形最低點取一格點，畫 theta 隨時間、高度的變化；下層 theta 隨高度陡升代表逆溫，長時間低 theta 滯留代表冷池。
zh.common_misreadings: 把「最低點」誤認為使用者指定的特定測站；此處是自動抓取的地形極小值格點，未必是有人居住的谷地。

en.question: Does a cold pool or temperature inversion form in the valley?
en.how_to_read: Theta vs. time/height at the domain's lowest-terrain grid point -- a steep low-level theta increase with height marks an inversion; low theta lingering at the surface marks a cold pool.
en.common_misreadings: Assuming the "lowest point" is a named station; it is the automatically-detected terrain minimum, not necessarily an inhabited valley.

zh.question: 背風測站有沒有焚風（T2 上升、RH 下降、陣風增強）？
zh.how_to_read: 測站：專案 input/obs/stations/ 的 NOAA ISD-Lite。沿 700 hPa 風向、山脊下風處 30–100 km、離剖面線 25 km 以內，選離山脊最近、有觀測且在模式內部的測站；畫最近格點的模式 T2、RH2、10 m 風速與觀測的時間序列。焚風訊號是 T2 上升、RH 下降、風速增強同時出現。
zh.common_misreadings: 把單一測站的差異當成整個背風面的表現；也把缺項當成沒有焚風——缺項只表示背風窗內沒有可用測站，原因寫在缺項裡。

en.question: Does a lee-side station show a foehn signal (T2 up, RH down, gustier wind)?
en.how_to_read: Stations: NOAA ISD-Lite from the project's input/obs/stations/. The station nearest the crest in the lee window (30-100 km downstream of the ridge along the 700 hPa wind, within 25 km of the section line, with observations, inside the model interior) is picked; model T2, RH2 and 10 m wind speed at the nearest grid cell are plotted against its observations. A foehn shows as T2 up, RH down and wind up together.
en.common_misreadings: Reading one station as the whole lee slope; reading a missing entry as "no foehn" -- it only means no usable station sat in the lee window, and the entry says why.

zh.question: 模式的地形性天氣是否通過測站觀測驗證？
zh.how_to_read: 與 precip_stn_series／precip_stn_map 同一套流程（NOAA ISD-Lite、MET Point-Stat），只是用地形網域：上圖是 2 m 溫度、露點、10 m 風速與海平面氣壓的 ME（模式減觀測）與 RMSE 時間序列，另一張是各站平均偏差地圖（T2、10 m 風速、海平面氣壓，三者都沒有配對時改畫露點）。只用網域內部（interior）的測站；時段內沒有任何模式與觀測配對的變數不畫（例如 ISD-Lite 該時段溫度缺測時就沒有 T2 那一格）。降水也跑在同一個網域時不重複畫，改為一行 info。
zh.common_misreadings: 把偏差全當成地形造成的誤差——沒有做測站高度修正，山區測站的 T2 偏差常來自模式地形高度與測站高度不同；測站少時統計不穩。

en.question: Is the model's terrain-driven weather verified against station observations?
en.how_to_read: The precip_stn_series / precip_stn_map pipeline (NOAA ISD-Lite, MET Point-Stat) run on the terrain domain: CNT ME (model minus obs) and RMSE of 2 m temperature, dew point, 10 m wind speed and MSLP against time, plus a map of each station's mean bias (T2, 10 m wind speed, MSLP; dew point when none of these has a pair). Only stations inside the interior mask are used, and a variable with no model-observation pair in the window has no panel (e.g. no T2 panel when ISD-Lite reports no temperature then). When precip runs on the same domain the figure is not repeated; an info note says so.
en.common_misreadings: Reading the whole bias as terrain error -- no station-elevation correction is applied, so mountain stations' T2 bias often comes from the model terrain height differing from the station's; few stations make the statistics unstable.

zh.question: 大氣柱總水氣含量（可降水量）的空間分布？
zh.how_to_read: 填色為可降水量 PW（wrf-python getvar('pw')），單位 kg/m2（等於 mm 液態水柱高）。
zh.common_misreadings: 把 PW 高值誤讀為正在下雨的區域；PW 只反映柱狀水氣總量，不代表降水正在發生。

en.question: What is the spatial distribution of total column water vapour (precipitable water)?
en.how_to_read: Fill is precipitable water PW (wrf-python's own 'pw' diagnostic), kg/m2 (equivalently mm of liquid water column).
en.common_misreadings: Reading high PW as an actively-raining area; PW is only the column total, not an indicator that precipitation is occurring.

zh.question: 過去幾小時水氣是否明顯增加或減少？
zh.how_to_read: 填色為 PW 的時段變化（cdo sub 計算），正值代表水氣增加，常領先對流發展數小時。
zh.common_misreadings: 把變化圖的顏色尺度誤讀成絕對 PW 值；這是差值，不是瞬時量。

en.question: Has column water vapour increased or decreased noticeably over the last several hours?
en.how_to_read: Fill is the period change in PW (computed with cdo sub); positive values (moisture increase) often lead convective development by several hours.
en.common_misreadings: Reading the change map's colour scale as an absolute PW value; it is a difference, not an instantaneous field.

zh.question: 低層噴流帶來多強的水氣通量（atmospheric river 強度）？
zh.how_to_read: 填色為積分水氣通量 IVT，風羽為 850 hPa 風；IVT 高值帶常與 atmospheric river / TC 外圍雨帶對應。
zh.common_misreadings: 把 IVT 誤讀成降水量；IVT 是水氣輸送的通量，不是已經落下的雨量，兩者可能不同步。

en.question: How strong is the low-level moisture flux (atmospheric-river-strength transport)?
en.how_to_read: Fill is integrated vapor transport IVT, barbs are 850 hPa wind; high-IVT bands often track atmospheric rivers / a TC's outer rainbands.
en.common_misreadings: Reading IVT as precipitation itself; it is a transport flux, not rain that has already fallen -- the two can be out of phase.

zh.question: 水氣的垂直結構（哪個高度層最濕、是否有乾層侵入）？
zh.how_to_read: 填色為相對濕度 RH，黑色等值線為相當位溫 theta_e；剖面線預設過颶風中心或最大雨量區。
zh.common_misreadings: 把乾層（低 RH）誤讀為模式錯誤；中層乾侵入是常見的真實天氣訊號。

en.question: What is the vertical structure of moisture (which layer is wettest, is a dry layer intruding)?
en.how_to_read: Fill is relative humidity RH, black contours are equivalent potential temperature theta_e; the line defaults through the TC centre or the max-rain point.
en.common_misreadings: Reading a dry layer (low RH) as a model error; mid-level dry-air intrusion is a common, real weather signal.

zh.question: 選定點的水氣垂直廓線如何隨時間演變？
zh.how_to_read: 填色為比濕，x 軸為時間，y 軸為高度；可看出濕層增厚/變薄的時序。
zh.common_misreadings: 把 y 軸的模式層當成等距的實際高度間隔；模式垂直層並非等距。

en.question: How does the moisture profile at a chosen point evolve over time?
en.how_to_read: Fill is specific humidity, x-axis time, y-axis height -- shows the moist layer thickening/thinning over the run.
en.common_misreadings: Treating the y-axis model levels as evenly-spaced physical heights; WRF's vertical levels are not evenly spaced.

zh.question: 雲水、雨水、冰與雪各有多少？分布在哪裡？
zh.how_to_read: 每個面板是一個水凝物組的柱積分路徑（g m⁻²，對乾空氣層質量積分）：LWP（QCLOUD）、RWP（QRAIN）、IWP（QICE）、SWP（QSNOW+QGRAUP+QHAIL）、TWP（全部），只畫這個 wrfout 有的種類；對數色階 1–2000 g m⁻²（小於 1 不著色）；風標為 10 m 風（kt，地球座標）。有 --every 時每個時間各一張。
zh.common_misreadings: 只看 LWP+IWP 判斷雲量——在 Thompson 或 WSM5 下，雪常是凝結物質量的大宗（湖效應雪幾乎全在 SWP）；把 IWP 小當成沒有冰雲——雪與霰被算在 SWP。

en.question: How much cloud water, rain, ice and snow is there, and where?
en.how_to_read: Each panel is one hydrometeor group's column path (g m-2, integrated over the dry-air layer mass): LWP (QCLOUD), RWP (QRAIN), IWP (QICE), SWP (QSNOW+QGRAUP+QHAIL), TWP (all), only the species this wrfout holds; log scale 1-2000 g m-2 (below 1 unshaded); barbs are 10 m wind in kt (earth-relative). With --every, one figure per selected time.
en.common_misreadings: Judging cloud amount from LWP+IWP alone -- with Thompson or WSM5 snow is often most of the condensate mass (lake-effect snow is almost all SWP); reading small IWP as no ice cloud -- snow and graupel are counted in SWP.

zh.question: 雲頂有多高？哪些雲有降水回波？
zh.how_to_read: 填色為雲頂高度（km MSL）：該柱中總凝結物 ≥ 0.01 g/kg 的最高模式層；白色為無雲柱；洋紅與紅線為組合回波 15 與 25 dBZ（OWLeS 湖效應研究 Gaudet et al. 2021 所用的回波門檻）。
zh.common_misreadings: 把雲頂高度當成衛星雲頂——門檻 0.01 g/kg 會包含很薄的雲，衛星看到的光學雲頂通常較低；把沒有 15 dBZ 的雲當成不下雪——弱的小雪回波可能低於 15 dBZ。

en.question: How high are the cloud tops, and which clouds carry precipitation echoes?
en.how_to_read: Fill is cloud-top height (km MSL): the highest model level whose total condensate is >= 0.01 g/kg; white = cloudless column; magenta/red lines are composite reflectivity 15 and 25 dBZ (the echo thresholds used for lake-effect bands in the OWLeS study, Gaudet et al. 2021).
en.common_misreadings: Equating it with a satellite cloud top -- the 0.01 g/kg threshold includes very thin cloud, so the optical top seen by a satellite is usually lower; reading a cloud without 15 dBZ as not snowing -- light snow can stay below 15 dBZ.

zh.question: 最濃雲柱的雲垂直結構：雲多深、在邊界層內還是穿出、是否位於樹枝狀冰晶成長溫度帶？
zh.how_to_read: 兩個剖面通過內部區域總水路徑 TWP 最大的柱：上圖沿該點 PBLH 以下的平均（網格相對）風向（即湖效應的 fetch 方向），下圖與之垂直；各 ±150 km（超出 domain 時截斷）。填色為總凝結物（對數 0.01–1 g/kg），粗實線 0 °C、虛線 −15 °C（樹枝狀冰晶成長帶），橘線為 PBLH 高度，紅/藍為上升/下沉 w，灰色為地形。高度上限依剖面上的雲頂自動取 4–18 km。
zh.common_misreadings: 把剖面方向當成正東西——它是沿邊界層平均風；邊界層風很弱（< 0.5 m/s）時改用網格 x/y 軸，標題會說明；把單一時刻的剖面當成雲帶的長期結構。

en.question: Vertical structure of the densest cloud column: how deep is the cloud, does it stay in or break out of the boundary layer, does it reach the dendritic-growth temperature zone?
en.how_to_read: Two sections through the interior column of maximum total water path TWP: the upper one along the mean (grid-relative) wind below PBLH at that point -- the lake-effect fetch -- and the lower one perpendicular to it, +-150 km each (clipped to the domain). Fill is total condensate (log 0.01-1 g/kg); bold solid 0 degC, dashed -15 degC (dendritic growth zone); orange line = PBLH; red/blue = up/down w; grey = terrain. The height window adapts to the cloud top on the sections (4-18 km).
en.common_misreadings: Taking the section as east-west -- it follows the mean boundary-layer wind; with a calm BL wind (< 0.5 m/s) the grid x/y axes are used and the title says so; reading one snapshot as the band's long-term structure.

zh.question: 從「衛星視角」看，雲頂溫度分布如何？哪裡是深對流、哪裡是低雲？

zh.question: 模式的 2 m 溫度、露點、10 m 風速與海平面氣壓相對地面測站偏差多少、如何隨時間變化？
zh.how_to_read: 測站：NOAA ISD-Lite（NCEI）。MET ascii2nc 轉成點觀測，MET Point-Stat 每個有效時刻把模式（cdo remapbil 到經緯度格網）雙線性內插到測站，於模式內部多邊形內配對；CNT 的 ME（模式減觀測）與 RMSE 畫成時間序列。時段內沒有任何配對的變數不畫。
zh.common_misreadings: 把偏差當成模式物理誤差——沒有做測站高度修正；ISD 測站少（每時刻約十餘站）且集中在陸地/海岸，統計不穩；日夜循環常造成偏差的週期起伏。

en.question: How large is the model's 2 m temperature, dew point, 10 m wind speed and MSLP error against surface stations, and how does it evolve?
en.how_to_read: Stations: NOAA ISD-Lite (NCEI). MET ascii2nc converts them to point observations; MET Point-Stat interpolates the model (moved to lat/lon with cdo remapbil) bilinearly to each station at every valid time, paired inside the model interior polygon; CNT ME (model minus obs) and RMSE are plotted against time. A variable with no pair in the window has no panel.
en.common_misreadings: Reading the bias as pure physics error -- no station-elevation correction is applied; only ~a dozen stations pair per time, mostly coastal/land; diurnal cycles make the bias oscillate.

zh.question: 哪些測站的模式偏差最大？空間上有沒有系統性的偏差型態？
zh.how_to_read: 每個圓點是一個 ISD-Lite 測站，顏色為整段（去除 spin-up）MET Point-Stat 配對（MPR）的平均『模式減觀測』，色階對稱、逐變數獨立。
zh.common_misreadings: 把單一站的偏差當成區域性結論；站點稀疏，且海岸站受海陸風與格點陸海遮罩影響。

en.question: Which stations show the largest model error, and is there a spatial pattern?
en.how_to_read: Each dot is an ISD-Lite station coloured by its mean model-minus-observation over the run (post spin-up) from MET Point-Stat matched pairs (MPR); symmetric scale, one per variable.
en.common_misreadings: Generalising from one station; stations are sparse and coastal ones are sensitive to sea-breeze and the model land/sea mask.

zh.question: 在 20/35/45 dBZ 下，模式對強回波的命中與誤報如何？
zh.how_to_read: MET Grid-Stat（觀測：雷達合成）各取樣時刻的 CTC 計數加總後算 POD、FAR、CSI、頻率偏差 FBIAS，橫軸為反射率門檻；時刻數見報告。若專案沒有 MRMS／NEXRAD，會改用 agent 找來並通過 `wtune event obs-check` 的雷達資料（wtune-obs/1 的 refl_*.nc），來源見圖下標示。
zh.common_misreadings: 把彙整分數當成單一時刻的表現；門檻越高事件越少，分數越不穩定。

en.question: How well does the model hit or falsely alarm strong echoes at 20/35/45 dBZ?
en.how_to_read: MET Grid-Stat (observation: radar composite): contingency counts (CTC) of every sampled time are summed, then POD, FAR, CSI and frequency bias FBIAS are formed, against reflectivity threshold; number of times in the report. Without MRMS / NEXRAD the comparison uses radar data an agent fetched (wtune-obs/1 refl_*.nc, passed `wtune event obs-check`); the source tag names it.
en.common_misreadings: Taking the pooled score as the skill of a single time; higher thresholds have fewer events and less stable scores.

zh.question: 模式的探空曲線和 IGRA2 探空觀測差多少？
zh.how_to_read: 每個測站與時刻一張 Skew-T：實線是 WRF、虛線是 IGRA2 無線電探空（溫度與露點），並列出 1000–500 hPa 的 T、Td、風速 RMSE。
zh.common_misreadings: 把探空的漂移（氣球在上升中飄離測站）與探空時間差忽略；1000–500 hPa 之外不計入 RMSE。

en.question: How far is the model sounding from the IGRA2 radiosonde?
en.how_to_read: One Skew-T per station and time: WRF solid, IGRA2 radiosonde dashed (temperature and dew point), with the 1000-500 hPa RMSE of T, Td and wind speed.
en.common_misreadings: Ignoring balloon drift and the sonde-to-model time offset; levels outside 1000-500 hPa are not in the RMSE.

zh.question: 模式的邊界層高度與探空推得的邊界層高度是否相近？
zh.how_to_read: WRF 的 PBLH 有兩種：由總體理察森數 Ri=0.25 推得的，以及 PBL 方案自己輸出的；再與探空以同樣總體 Ri 法推得的 PBLH 比較（Seibert et al. 2000；Vogelezang & Holtslag 1996）。
zh.common_misreadings: 把它當成驗證——探空垂直解析度粗，這只是合理性檢查而非驗證。

en.question: Is the model PBL height close to the one derived from radiosondes?
en.how_to_read: WRF PBLH from the bulk Richardson number Ri = 0.25 and from the PBL scheme, against radiosonde PBLH by the same bulk-Ri method (Seibert et al. 2000; Vogelezang & Holtslag 1996).
en.common_misreadings: Treating it as verification -- radiosonde vertical resolution is coarse, so this is a plausibility check, not a verification.

zh.question: 各季節的 2 m 溫度偏差分布在哪裡？
zh.how_to_read: DJF/MAM/JJA/SON 的模式減 ERA5（T2）月平均差圖；季節以天數加權，不完整的季節不會被平均進去。
zh.common_misreadings: 把只涵蓋部分月份的季節當成完整季節；地形陡處模式與 0.25° 再分析的高度差會直接造成 T2 偏差。

en.question: Where does the 2 m temperature bias lie, season by season?
en.how_to_read: DJF/MAM/JJA/SON model-minus-ERA5 maps of monthly-mean T2; seasons are weighted by days and partial seasons are never averaged.
en.common_misreadings: Treating a season covered by only some of its months as complete; over steep terrain the model-vs-0.25 deg height mismatch directly produces T2 bias.

zh.question: 各季節的降水偏差分布在哪裡？
zh.how_to_read: DJF/MAM/JJA/SON 的模式減 GPCP v2.3 降水差圖（mm/day）；季節以天數加權，不完整的季節不會被平均進去。
zh.common_misreadings: GPCP 只有 2.5°，在約 50 km 的模式解析度下，海岸與地形附近的偏差主要來自解析度不匹配，不一定是模式錯誤。

en.question: Where does the precipitation bias lie, season by season?
en.how_to_read: DJF/MAM/JJA/SON model-minus-GPCP v2.3 precipitation maps (mm/day); seasons are weighted by days and partial seasons are never averaged.
en.common_misreadings: GPCP is 2.5 deg, so at about 50 km the bias near coasts and terrain is dominated by the resolution mismatch, not necessarily a model error.

zh.question: 模式累積降水的位置與強度，和 agent 找來的格點降水觀測相比如何？
zh.how_to_read: 左為模式、右為觀測，同一色階、只畫兩者皆有值的匹配格點，限制在模式內部（去掉 spec_bdy_width 邊界區）。模式先以 cdo remapcon 轉到經緯度格網，再由 MET Grid-Stat 以 BUDGET 法重新網格化到觀測自己的格網。觀測是 agent 依 wtune-event skill 找來、轉成 WTune 標準格式（wtune-obs/1）並通過 `wtune event obs-check` 的資料集，名稱、提供者、授權寫在圖下的來源標示。
zh.common_misreadings: 把衛星或雷達反演當成真值；格點降水產品在山區、海上與對流核心常有系統性偏差。觀測格網較粗時，模式的極值會被平滑掉。

en.question: How do model accumulated-precipitation position and amount compare with the gridded precipitation an agent fetched?
en.how_to_read: Left model, right observation, one colour scale, matched cells only, inside the model interior (spec_bdy_width cells excluded). The model is moved to a lat/lon grid with cdo remapcon, then MET Grid-Stat regrids it (BUDGET) onto the observation's own grid. The observation is a dataset an agent fetched with the wtune-event skill, converted to WTune's standard format (wtune-obs/1) and passed `wtune event obs-check`; its name, provider and licence are in the source tag under the figure.
en.common_misreadings: Taking a satellite or radar retrieval as truth: gridded products are biased over mountains, oceans and convective cores. On a coarse observation grid the model's extremes are smoothed.

zh.question: 模式和 agent 找來的格點降水差在哪裡？
zh.how_to_read: 模式減觀測，對稱色階（98 百分位），只在匹配格點。觀測是 agent 依 wtune-event skill 找來、轉成 WTune 標準格式（wtune-obs/1）並通過 `wtune event obs-check` 的資料集，名稱、提供者、授權寫在圖下的來源標示。
zh.common_misreadings: 位置偏移會同時出現一正一負的偶極，不代表兩處各自有誤。

en.question: Where does the model differ from the gridded precipitation an agent fetched?
en.how_to_read: Model minus observation, symmetric scale (98th percentile), matched cells only. The observation is a dataset an agent fetched with the wtune-event skill, converted to WTune's standard format (wtune-obs/1) and passed `wtune event obs-check`; its name, provider and licence are in the source tag under the figure.
en.common_misreadings: A displaced rain area shows as a positive/negative dipole, not as two separate errors.

zh.question: 各雨量門檻下，模式和 agent 找來的格點降水的類別分數如何？
zh.how_to_read: MET Grid-Stat CTS：POD、FAR、CSI、頻率偏差，x 軸是門檻（mm）；n 是匹配格點數。觀測是 agent 依 wtune-event skill 找來、轉成 WTune 標準格式（wtune-obs/1）並通過 `wtune event obs-check` 的資料集，名稱、提供者、授權寫在圖下的來源標示。
zh.common_misreadings: 高門檻的格點很少時分數變動很大；頻率偏差 1 只代表面積對，不代表位置對。

en.question: What are the categorical scores against the agent-fetched gridded precipitation at each threshold?
en.how_to_read: MET Grid-Stat CTS: POD, FAR, CSI, frequency bias against threshold (mm); n is the number of matched cells. The observation is a dataset an agent fetched with the wtune-event skill, converted to WTune's standard format (wtune-obs/1) and passed `wtune event obs-check`; its name, provider and licence are in the source tag under the figure.
en.common_misreadings: Few cells above a high threshold make the score noisy; a frequency bias of 1 means the right area, not the right place.

zh.question: 在多大的空間尺度上，模式降水和 agent 找來的格點降水才算吻合？
zh.how_to_read: MET Grid-Stat NBRCNT 的 FSS 對鄰域寬度（以觀測格點數換算成 km），每條線一個門檻。觀測是 agent 依 wtune-event skill 找來、轉成 WTune 標準格式（wtune-obs/1）並通過 `wtune event obs-check` 的資料集，名稱、提供者、授權寫在圖下的來源標示。
zh.common_misreadings: km 換算用觀測格網的平均緯度間距，經度方向在高緯會較窄。

en.question: At what spatial scale does the model rain agree with the agent-fetched gridded precipitation?
en.how_to_read: MET Grid-Stat NBRCNT FSS against neighbourhood width (observation cells converted to km), one line per threshold. The observation is a dataset an agent fetched with the wtune-event skill, converted to WTune's standard format (wtune-obs/1) and passed `wtune event obs-check`; its name, provider and licence are in the source tag under the figure.
en.common_misreadings: The km scale uses the mean latitude spacing of the observation grid; cells are narrower in longitude at high latitude.

zh.question: 模式在雨量站位置的累積雨量，和 agent 找來的雨量站觀測相比如何？
zh.how_to_read: 每點是一個雨量站一個累積時段：x 為觀測、y 為模式（MET Point-Stat 以雙線性內插到站點，限模式內部），虛線為 1:1。標題列出配對數、平均偏差（模式減觀測）、RMSE、相關係數。觀測是 agent 依 wtune-event skill 找來、轉成 WTune 標準格式（wtune-obs/1）並通過 `wtune event obs-check` 的資料集，名稱、提供者、授權寫在圖下的來源標示。
zh.common_misreadings: 格點平均雨量和單點雨量本來就不同，強降雨時模式在點上偏低不一定是模式錯；雨量站在強風下會少接雨。

en.question: How does the model accumulation at the gauges compare with the rain gauges an agent fetched?
en.how_to_read: Each dot is one gauge and one accumulation period: x observation, y model (MET Point-Stat, bilinear to the gauge, model interior only); dashed 1:1 line. The title gives pairs, mean bias (model minus obs), RMSE and correlation. The observation is a dataset an agent fetched with the wtune-event skill, converted to WTune's standard format (wtune-obs/1) and passed `wtune event obs-check`; its name, provider and licence are in the source tag under the figure.
en.common_misreadings: A grid-cell mean is not a point total: a model low at the gauge in heavy rain is not necessarily a model error; gauges under-catch in strong wind.

zh.question: 哪些雨量站的模式偏差最大？空間上有沒有系統性的型態？
zh.how_to_read: 每個圓點是一個雨量站，顏色為所有時段配對的平均『模式減觀測』，對稱色階（95 百分位）。觀測是 agent 依 wtune-event skill 找來、轉成 WTune 標準格式（wtune-obs/1）並通過 `wtune event obs-check` 的資料集，名稱、提供者、授權寫在圖下的來源標示。
zh.common_misreadings: 站點稀疏時不要把單站偏差推到整個區域；山區站對模式地形高度很敏感。

en.question: Which gauges show the largest model error, and is there a spatial pattern?
en.how_to_read: Each dot is a gauge coloured by its mean model-minus-observation over all periods; symmetric scale (95th percentile). The observation is a dataset an agent fetched with the wtune-event skill, converted to WTune's standard format (wtune-obs/1) and passed `wtune event obs-check`; its name, provider and licence are in the source tag under the figure.
en.common_misreadings: Do not generalise one gauge to a region; mountain gauges are sensitive to the model's terrain height.

zh.question: 模式的雲頂（OLR 換算亮溫）和衛星紅外亮溫在位置上是否一致？
zh.how_to_read: 左為模式 OLR 換算的等效黑體溫度，右為衛星紅外窗區亮溫，都放在模式的經緯度網格上（觀測以 cdo remapcon 平均），同一色階（240 K 以下彩色），只畫兩者皆有值的格點；選取觀測 ≤220 K 面積最大的時刻。觀測是 agent 找來、轉成 wtune-obs/1 並通過 `wtune event obs-check` 的資料集，名稱與授權見圖下標示。
zh.common_misreadings: 模式值是寬頻 OLR 代理量，在高雲上比窗區頻道偏暖，所以冷雲面積偏小不一定是模式少了雲；低雲與地表溫差小，這張圖幾乎看不出。

en.question: Do model cloud tops (OLR-derived Tb) and satellite IR brightness temperature agree in position?
en.how_to_read: Left model OLR-derived equivalent blackbody temperature, right satellite IR window brightness temperature, both on the model lat/lon grid (obs averaged with cdo remapcon), one scale (colour below 240 K), matched cells only; the time with the most observed area <= 220 K is shown. The observation is a dataset an agent fetched in wtune-obs/1 format that passed `wtune event obs-check`; the source tag names it.
en.common_misreadings: The model value is a broadband OLR proxy, warmer than a window channel over high cloud, so a smaller cold-cloud area is not necessarily missing cloud; low cloud barely differs from the surface here.

zh.question: 以冷雲頂（亮溫 ≤ 門檻）為事件，模式的命中與誤報如何？
zh.how_to_read: MET Grid-Stat 類別分數，事件是亮溫 ≤ 240、220、210 K，所有時刻的列聯表合併後計算；Roebber 圖上越靠右上越好。觀測是 agent 找來、轉成 wtune-obs/1 並通過 `wtune event obs-check` 的資料集，名稱與授權見圖下標示。
zh.common_misreadings: OLR 代理量在高雲上偏暖，會讓頻率偏差系統性小於 1。

en.question: With cold tops (Tb <= threshold) as events, how do hits and false alarms look?
en.how_to_read: MET Grid-Stat categorical scores for Tb <= 240, 220, 210 K, contingency counts pooled over all times; up and right is better on the Roebber diagram. The observation is a dataset an agent fetched in wtune-obs/1 format that passed `wtune event obs-check`; the source tag names it.
en.common_misreadings: The OLR proxy runs warm over high cloud, which pushes the frequency bias below 1 systematically.

zh.question: 冷雲頂在多大的空間尺度上和衛星吻合？
zh.how_to_read: MET Grid-Stat NBRCNT 的 FSS 對鄰域寬度（模式格點數 × 格距），每條線一個亮溫門檻，所有時刻合併。觀測是 agent 找來、轉成 wtune-obs/1 並通過 `wtune event obs-check` 的資料集，名稱與授權見圖下標示。
zh.common_misreadings: 同上：寬頻代理量的偏暖會壓低高門檻的 FSS。

en.question: At what scale do model cold tops match the satellite?
en.how_to_read: MET Grid-Stat NBRCNT FSS against neighbourhood width (model cells x grid spacing), one line per Tb threshold, pooled over all times. The observation is a dataset an agent fetched in wtune-obs/1 format that passed `wtune event obs-check`; the source tag names it.
en.common_misreadings: As above: the warm broadband proxy lowers FSS at the coldest thresholds.

zh.question: 模式陣風和測站陣風相比如何？
zh.how_to_read: 每點是一個測站一個時刻：x 觀測、y 模式（MET Point-Stat 雙線性內插、限模式內部）。模式陣風有 WSPD10MAX 就用，否則用 NCEP UPP 的 CALGUST（PBL 頂風速往下混合）；方法寫在標題。觀測是 agent 找來、轉成 wtune-obs/1 並通過 `wtune event obs-check` 的資料集，名稱與授權見圖下標示。
zh.common_misreadings: 測站陣風是數秒的峰值，模式是格點與輸出時刻的診斷值，模式偏低是常態；只在有陣風報告的時刻才有點（弱風時多數測站不報陣風）。

en.question: How do model gusts compare with station gusts?
en.how_to_read: Each dot is one station and time: x observation, y model (MET Point-Stat, bilinear, model interior). The model gust is WSPD10MAX when written, else NCEP UPP CALGUST (PBL-top wind mixed down); the title names the method. The observation is a dataset an agent fetched in wtune-obs/1 format that passed `wtune event obs-check`; the source tag names it.
en.common_misreadings: A station gust is a few-second peak, the model a grid-cell diagnostic at the output time, so a low model is normal; only times with a reported gust appear (most stations report none in light wind).

zh.question: 哪些測站的模式陣風偏差最大？
zh.how_to_read: 每個圓點是一個測站，顏色為所有時刻的平均「模式減觀測」陣風，對稱色階（95 百分位）。觀測是 agent 找來、轉成 wtune-obs/1 並通過 `wtune event obs-check` 的資料集，名稱與授權見圖下標示。
zh.common_misreadings: 配對數少的測站平均值不穩定；山區與海岸測站對格點地形與陸海遮罩敏感。

en.question: Which stations show the largest model gust error?
en.how_to_read: Each dot is a station coloured by its mean model-minus-observation gust over all times; symmetric scale (95th percentile). The observation is a dataset an agent fetched in wtune-obs/1 format that passed `wtune event obs-check`; the source tag names it.
en.common_misreadings: Means over few pairs are noisy; mountain and coastal stations are sensitive to model terrain and the land/sea mask.

zh.question: 模式能見度和測站能見度相比如何？
zh.how_to_read: 每點是一個測站一個時刻。模式能見度用 Stoelinga–Warner（1999，UPP CALVIS）由最低層雲水、雨、冰、雪的消光計算；模式與觀測都截在 16.1 km（ASOS 上限）。觀測是 agent 找來、轉成 wtune-obs/1 並通過 `wtune event obs-check` 的資料集，名稱與授權見圖下標示。
zh.common_misreadings: 這個方法不含霾與氣膠，晴空時模式一律是上限值；它比的是霧、低雲與降水造成的低能見度。

en.question: How does model visibility compare with station visibility?
en.how_to_read: Each dot is one station and time. Model visibility is Stoelinga-Warner (1999, UPP CALVIS) extinction from cloud water, rain, ice and snow at the lowest level; both are capped at 16.1 km (the ASOS maximum). The observation is a dataset an agent fetched in wtune-obs/1 format that passed `wtune event obs-check`; the source tag names it.
en.common_misreadings: The method has no haze or aerosol, so clear air is always at the cap; it tests fog, low cloud and precipitation, not dry-air visibility.

zh.question: 哪些測站的模式能見度偏差最大？
zh.how_to_read: 每個圓點是一個測站，顏色為平均「模式減觀測」能見度（m），對稱色階（95 百分位）。觀測是 agent 找來、轉成 wtune-obs/1 並通過 `wtune event obs-check` 的資料集，名稱與授權見圖下標示。
zh.common_misreadings: 截斷在 16.1 km 會讓晴天的偏差變成 0；大的負偏差代表模式在那裡起霧或降水太多。

en.question: Which stations show the largest model visibility error?
en.how_to_read: Each dot is a station coloured by its mean model-minus-observation visibility (m); symmetric scale (95th percentile). The observation is a dataset an agent fetched in wtune-obs/1 format that passed `wtune event obs-check`; the source tag names it.
en.common_misreadings: The 16.1 km cap makes clear-sky bias zero; a large negative bias means too much model fog or precipitation there.

zh.question: 指定的巢狀網格（post.map_domains）內，地形與（若開啟）10 m 風長什麼樣子？
zh.how_to_read: 地圖範圍就是該層網格的邊界，底色是該層自己的地形高度（解析度比 d01 高）；風羽（若有）是畫圖時刻的 10 m 風，一個全羽 10 節、半羽 5 節，朝向為風的來向。
zh.common_misreadings: 把風羽當成時間平均；它只是單一時刻。地形色階和 d01 總覽圖相同但解析度不同，山谷在 d01 上可能整條不見。

en.question: What do the terrain and (when enabled) the 10 m wind look like inside the nests listed in post.map_domains?
en.how_to_read: The extent is that nest's own boundary and the shading is that nest's own terrain height (finer than d01); barbs, when present, are the 10 m wind at the stated valid time (full barb 10 kt, half barb 5 kt, pointing into the wind).
en.common_misreadings: Reading the barbs as a time mean; they are one instant. The colour scale matches the d01 overview but the nest resolves valleys that d01 smooths away.

zh.question: 模式在這個測站的 T2、露點、10 m 風速／風向、陣風，和觀測差多少？各層巢狀網格哪一層較接近？
zh.how_to_read: 黑線是測站觀測（風向圖只畫觀測風速不小於靜風門檻的點），每條彩線是一個包含該站的 domain（圖例括號為所取格點的模式地形高）。模式值取最近格點或雙線性內插（標題寫明），沒有做站高修正，所以山區或海岸站的溫度差要和 station_stats.csv 的 model_hgt_minus_elev_m 一起看；站高未提供時該欄為空。觀測時間與最近的模式輸出時間差在容許值（預設 10 分鐘）內才配對。標題的 bias 是模式減觀測，RMSE 同單位。風向差用環狀差 ((模式-觀測+180) mod 360) - 180，bias 是環狀差的平均，RMSE 是環狀差的均方根；觀測風速低於靜風門檻（預設 3 kt）的配對不進風向統計，筆數記在 n_calm_excluded。陣風的模式值是 WSPD10MAX（有寫出時）或 UPP 式估計，不是同一個取樣間隔的極大值。ASOS 只在有陣風時才填 gust（M 代表沒有陣風），所以陣風面板只含有陣風的時刻（標題 gust reports only，n 通常很小），bias/RMSE 不是全時段的陣風表現；station_stats.csv 的 note 欄同樣標示。最外一圈邊界格點不比較。
zh.common_misreadings: 把風向在 0/360 附近的跳動當成誤差（線在跨越時已斷開，統計用環狀差）；把不同高度的格點與站的溫度差全當成物理偏差（沒有站高修正）；把最近格點的值當成站點周圍的平均。

en.question: How far are the model's T2, dew point, 10 m wind speed / direction and gust from the station observations, and which nest is closer?
en.how_to_read: The black line is the station observation (the wind-direction panel draws only observations at or above the calm threshold); each coloured line is one domain that contains the station, the legend giving the model terrain height at the sampled grid point. The model value is the nearest grid point or a bilinear interpolation (named in the title); there is NO station-height correction, so read temperature differences together with model_hgt_minus_elev_m in station_stats.csv (empty when the station height was not supplied). An observation is paired with the nearest model output time only within the tolerance (default 10 min). bias in the title is model minus observation. Direction differences are circular, d = ((model - obs + 180) mod 360) - 180; bias is the mean of d, RMSE the root mean square of d; pairs with observed speed below the calm threshold (default 3 kt) are excluded from the direction statistics and counted in n_calm_excluded. The model gust is WSPD10MAX when the run wrote it, else a UPP-style estimate, and is not a maximum over the same sampling interval as the observation. ASOS fills gust only when a gust occurred (M = no gust), so the gust panel holds gust reports only (title: gust reports only; n is often small) and its bias/RMSE is not gust skill over all hours; the note column of station_stats.csv says so too. Grid points on the outermost ring are not compared.
en.common_misreadings: Reading 0/360 wrap-around as error (the line is broken there and the statistics are circular); attributing a temperature difference at a station whose grid point is hundreds of metres off in height entirely to physics; treating the nearest-point value as an average around the station.
